definition: kH_pc in mol/(kg water bar); kH(T)=kH0*exp(B*(1/T-1/298.15K))

NH3.name: ammonia
NH3.selection: NIST literature-review entry for neutral dissolved NH3; NH4+ is speciated separately after transfer
NH3.temperature_note: The exponential temperature form is extrapolated toward the boiling compartment; quantitative high-temperature partition is not validated.

CO2.name: carbon dioxide
CO2.selection: NIST literature-review entry; neutral dissolved CO2 plus hydrated carbonic acid pool is speciated separately after transfer
CO2.temperature_note: The exponential temperature form is extrapolated toward the boiling compartment; do not treat its high-temperature value as measured.

CH2O.name: formaldehyde
CH2O.selection: effective value near the measured Betterton-Hoffmann/Sander entries; not an intrinsic free-CH2O Henry constant
CH2O.source_note: Sander 2023 methanal note 457 defines the effective solubility as ([HCHO]+[CH2(OH)2])/p(HCHO). Treating this pool as free aqueous CH2O omits explicit hydration and is not a validated kinetic model.

scope_note: This property subset is independent of any Miller-Urey product benchmark. Species without an entry remain in their existing compartment.
